name: FileGlow Enhanced File Downloads
author: wpalkemy

sections.description:
FileGlow automatically adds visual indicators and file size information to your downloadable content, making your site more professional and user-friendly.

Make your file downloads more intuitive and professional with FileGlow – the simple way to enhance your WordPress file blocks.

Transform your WordPress file downloads with elegant file type icons and smart size displays. FileGlow automatically adds visual indicators and file size information to your downloadable content, making your site more professional and user-friendly.

FEATURES

  • Automatic file type detection and icon display
  • Smart file size display (B, KB, MB, GB)
  • Clean integration with WordPress block editor
  • Supports common file formats (PDF, DOC, ZIP, MP3, MP4, and more)
  • No configuration needed – works right out of the box
  • Lightweight and performance-optimized
  • Compatible with all WordPress themes

PERFECT FOR

  • Document repositories
  • Digital product stores
  • Educational websites
  • Portfolio sites
  • Business websites
  • Any site offering file downloads

Credits

In plugin are used icons by Graphy Design, which are distributed under the terms of the CC BY 4.0 license.
sections.installation: Install the plugin either via the WordPress plugin directory by searching the plugin’s name “FileGlow” or by uploading the files to your server at wp-content/plugins.
